preview.notes: Preview v1.10: Explore themes is anchored at top-right of sticky navigation on desktop and compact mobile header, no longer nested with the floating Quick Actions launcher. Quick Actions is an icon-only round glass button at bottom-right with alpha blending, soft rotating halo, blur and themed contextual overlay, reduced-motion fallback and accessible tooltip/label. Theme Gallery and read-only contextual navigation behavior retained. Production promotion, private profile requests and inbox delivery remain disabled.
preview.testStatus: GitHub source readback and CSS/JS static checks pending; CircleCI browser regression assertions committed but no executed browser result verified. Cloudflare branch deployment still unverified.
